summary: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of common stock up to $500 million aggregate gross sales price. The company entered into an equity distribution agreement with multiple managers and forward sellers, allowing sales at prevailing market prices through brokers or block trades, or via forward sale agreements. No specific price, premium, or closing date is stated; the filing is a routine capital-raising under an existing shelf registration. The issuer will receive net proceeds after commissions of up to 1%. This is an ordinary ATM program, not a special situation. The deal_terms object is empty as no explicit terms are provided.
